en.name: Kinnav
en.subtitle: Safety, support and rewards
en.short_description: Personal safety for women: a guardian map, one-tap Safe Call and self-care.
en.description:
Kinnav is a personal safety and wellbeing companion built for women.

Getting home late. Walking to the car after a shift. A first date in an unfamiliar part of town. Kinnav is designed for the moments when you want someone with you, and a way to feel steadier the rest of the time.

REACH A GUARDIAN
Open the map and see the guardians around you. One tap on CALL GUARDIANS opens your options: voice, video, text, or a direct line to emergency services. No menus to dig through when you are in a hurry.

YOUR MAP
The map centres on you and shows who is nearby. Location is used to place you and the guardians around you, and nothing more.

EMERGENCY DIALLING
A confirmed one-tap route to 911. Kinnav is not a replacement for emergency services and never tries to be — when you need police, fire, or an ambulance, the app puts you straight through.

SAFETY CONTACTS
Keep the people who matter one tap away.

SELF-CARE MODULES
Short, practical lessons on situational awareness, boundaries, de-escalation, and recovery. Work through them at your own pace and keep your progress.

REWARDS
Finish modules and earn rewards you can redeem in the app.

CALL HISTORY
Every Safe Call is recorded in your history so you have a record of what happened and when.

EARLY ACCESS
Kinnav is in early access. The guardian network is still being built out, so the guardians you see are sample profiles and Safe Call is clearly labelled in the app as a simulation — it does not connect you to a live responder yet. Emergency dialling, your map, safety contacts, modules, and rewards all work today. We would rather tell you exactly where we are than overpromise on an app you might need in a bad moment.

PRIVACY
Location is used to show you and nearby guardians on the map. Your account is protected and your data is encrypted in transit. Read the full policy at https://kinnav.com/privacy

Questions or feedback: support@kinnav.com

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing Kinnav.

Kinnav is a personal safety and wellbeing app for women: a map of guardians, a
one-tap Safe Call, confirmed emergency dialling, safety contacts, self-care
modules and rewards.

SIGN-IN ACCOUNT
The Sign Up screen has a "Use test account" button that signs in with one tap.
If you prefer to type them, the credentials are supplied to App Review in the
"Sign-in required" fields of this submission (fastlane reads them from the
untracked demo_user.txt / demo_password.txt beside this file).

Authentication is Supabase email/password.

TEST INSTRUCTIONS
1. Launch the app and step through onboarding.
2. On the Sign Up screen tap "Use test account".
3. Complete the short profile step (name and age; the app enforces 18+).
4. You land on the guardian map. Allow location when prompted — the map centres
   on you and shows nearby guardians.
5. Tap CALL GUARDIANS to open the call options: Voice, Video, Text, Emergency.
6. Tap Voice or Video to see the Safe Call screen, or Text to open chat.
7. Open the drawer (top-left) for Profile, Safety Contacts, Call History,
   Modules, Rewards, Subscription, About and Legal.

PLEASE NOTE — WHAT IS AND IS NOT LIVE
We want to be explicit rather than have you discover it mid-review.

• The guardian network is not live yet. The guardians on the map are sample
  profiles.
• Safe Call is a simulation. The Safe Call screen states this on screen
  ("DEMO - simulated safe call"); it does not connect to a live responder.
• Emergency dialling is real. It asks for confirmation and then dials 911.
  Please do not confirm that dialog during review.
• Subscription screen is presentational in this build. No StoreKit products are
  configured and no purchase can be completed.

Everything else — account, profile, map, location, safety contacts, modules,
progress, rewards and call history — is fully functional.

NOT AN EMERGENCY SERVICE
Kinnav is not a medical or emergency service and is not a replacement for one.
The app and our Terms both say so, and the app routes users to 911 for real
emergencies.

PERMISSIONS
• Location (when in use): to place the user and nearby guardians on the map.
• Camera: for a video Safe Call.

TRACKING
No advertising or analytics SDK ships in this build and the app does not access
the IDFA, so no App Tracking Transparency prompt appears. This matches the
"does not use IDFA" answer in the submission.

Questions: support@kinnav.com — we reply within one business day.
